notes: Community adapter: flags are from the official aider.chat docs (2026-11-14) but the mode mapping is an inference, not an aider preset, and one-shot prompt behavior should be confirmed on your build. Prompt delivery is ARGUMENT via --message (aider documents no stdin prompt mode). readonly uses --chat-mode ask, which by design never makes changes. All modes pass --no-auto-commits so bridge work stays uncommitted for review. auto adds --yes-always (the options reference lists --yes-always; the scripting page also shows --yes - this adapter uses --yes-always). Aider has NO auth-status command: credentials are API keys in the environment, so authCheck is null and the runner skips preflight for this adapter. Jobs that need specific files should name them in the prompt text, or extend this adapter with --file entries.
